items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Ted Frank I knew when he was four years old.

ctx.x: We were talking about piano tuning and Whirlions. I've forgotten how long you were at Whirlions.

I have been on and off at Whirlions since 1926. That's before my time. Ted Frank I knew when he was four years old. Ted was four when I first went to work at Whirlions. Ted's been very very sick but he's recovering. Ted had a terrible heart condition. He lost oh some 40-50 pounds.
What did you do in 26 when you went to Whirlions?
